records.name: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct
records.summary: 7.61B-parameter instruction-tuned model; its model card describes long-context capability and Transformers/vLLM deployment guidance.
records.access: Public model weights and code are listed under Apache-2.0. Local inference is possible, but hardware, hosting, storage, and energy are not free; no hosted inference free tier is claimed.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Check the model repository license and any third-party quantization/runtime license before redistribution.

records.authentication: No hosted API authentication for downloaded weights; the Hugging Face account is optional for this public model repository.
records.quota_and_rate_limits: Not applicable to self-hosted weights. Hosted inference quotas depend on the selected provider; no free hosted quota verified.
sdk: vLLM deployment is recommended by the model card
records.privacy: For local inference, prompts stay within the operator's deployment unless the application separately sends them elsewhere. Hardware/runtime telemetry and deployment logs are operator-specific.
records.cors: Not applicable to local weights; hosted inference provider CORS is provider-specific and not asserted.

records.name: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3
records.summary: 7B instruction-tuned text model; the model card documents function calling and local/Transformers use.
records.access: Model card and release materials identify Apache-2.0 licensing. The card says this model does not include moderation mechanisms. Local compute/storage remain the operator's cost.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Verify the model repository's current license and any quantization/runtime terms before redistribution.

records.authentication: Public model repository; no hosted API key is required to download public files. Some mirrors/providers may impose their own access rules.
records.quota_and_rate_limits: Not applicable to self-hosted weights. The reviewed Hugging Face page said this model was not deployed by an Inference Provider at the time checked; no hosted API free tier is claimed.
records.privacy: Local inference can keep prompts on the operator's machine/network; hosted services have separate terms. Add safety controls because the model card notes no moderation mechanism.
records.cors: Not applicable to local weights; hosted provider/browser policies vary.

records.name: OpenAI gpt-oss-120b
records.summary: Open-weight 117B-parameter model with about 5.1B active parameters; the official repository describes single-80GB-GPU deployment for the 120B variant.
records.access: Weights and inference code are released under Apache-2.0 and the gpt-oss usage policy. Downloading is not equivalent to free compute; hardware requirements are substantial.

license.name: Apache-2.0 plus OpenAI gpt-oss usage policy
license.notes: Follow the usage policy and preserve notices. Hosted Groq/OpenRouter access is a separate service and may be paid.

records.authentication: Public weights/repository; provider-hosted inference requires that provider's key and terms.
records.quota_and_rate_limits: No self-hosted request quota. Hosted API pricing and limits are provider-specific; Groq's listed pricing is cataloged separately.
sdk: Official OpenAI gpt-oss repository includes inference implementations; see repository for current hardware/runtime instructions.
records.privacy: When self-hosted, prompt processing is controlled by the operator; hosted API/provider retention is separate. Apply safeguards before exposing model tools or reasoning traces.
records.cors: Not applicable to model weights; hosted service CORS is provider-specific.

records.name: Google Gemma 3 4B IT
records.summary: 4B multimodal open-weight model. Hugging Face requires agreement to Google's Gemma usage conditions before files are accessible.
records.access: Weights are gated behind acceptance of the Gemma terms. This is a custom conditional license, not described here as an OSI-approved open-source license. No hosted inference pricing is asserted.

license.name: Google Gemma Terms of Use
license.notes: Review distribution, use restrictions, eligibility, and downstream notice requirements before use; access conditions can change.

records.authentication: Hugging Face login and acceptance of model terms required to access gated files; local inference after authorized download.
records.quota_and_rate_limits: No public hosted-inference quota verified. Local runtime performance depends on hardware.
sdk: Transformers >=4.50.0 according to the model card
records.privacy: Local inference privacy is operator-controlled. Hosted provider policies vary; do not infer model-provider privacy from the weights license.
records.cors: Not applicable to weights; hosted inference CORS is provider-specific.

records.name: Meta Llama 3.2 3B Instruct
records.summary: 3B text-only instruction model under Meta's Llama 3.2 Community License and Acceptable Use Policy.
records.access: Hugging Face access is gated and requires accepting the Meta license/policy; the access screen says account information is shared under Meta's privacy policy. Not an OSI-approved open-source license claim.

license.name: Llama 3.2 Community License Agreement and Acceptable Use Policy
license.notes: Includes attribution/redistribution conditions, acceptable-use restrictions, and a special licensing clause for products above 700 million monthly active users. Review the complete current license.

records.authentication: Hugging Face login, account-information sharing, and acceptance of Meta terms required for gated model files.
records.quota_and_rate_limits: No hosted inference quota or pricing verified. Self-hosted compute is operator-funded.
sdk: Transformers and Meta reference tooling; see current model card and Llama documentation.
records.privacy: Local inference is operator-controlled after access. Hugging Face account information is shared as described by the access gate; hosted inference has separate provider policies.
records.cors: Not applicable to local weights; hosted inference provider/browser policy varies.
